newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris court bans cover of new French news mag.
newsitem.headline: Paris court bans cover of new French news mag.

text.p: A Paris court banned the cover of French weekly news magazine Marianne from Friday, May 2, Marianne's managing director said on Tuesday.

Albert Mallet was confirming reports that businessman Serge Dassault, chairman of Dassault Aviation, took the magazine to court over a reference to him on the cover of Marianne, which was launched on Monday.
"We do not intend to remove the cover and the inside pages of the magazine which refer to Serge Dassault. If there are copies still on the newsstands on Friday, we will withdraw them," Mallet said.
The reference to Dassault came in an article on arms trade.
Marianne printed 500,000 copies for its first issue. DT/SLA
